Know Your Doors

Choose like an expert.

A door is a 20-year decision. Here's what actually matters when you choose — the same guidance we give every customer who walks into our factory.

Laminate doors

Ranges: Grooving, T-Profile, Digital. A decorative laminate bonded over a solid flush-door core, then routed with groove patterns or inlaid with metallic T-profiles. Scratch-resistant, easy to wipe clean, and never needs polishing or painting. The workhorse of Indian homes — ideal for bedrooms and living areas.

Membrane doors

Range: AL-166 to 177. A PVC membrane is pressed onto the door under high temperature, wrapping edges seamlessly — no joints, no peeling lines. Moisture-resistant and zero-maintenance, available in our five signature shades. A smart choice for bedrooms and low-splash areas.

Digital UV & Micro Coated

Our showpiece ranges. High-definition art — florals, marble fusions, traditional motifs — printed and cured with UV or micro-coating technology for depth and gloss that flat laminates can't match. When you want the door itself to be the décor.

Teak doors

Range: AL-190 to 201. Solid teak with traditional joinery, carved panels and glass inserts. Naturally durable, ages beautifully, and carries the weight and sound of real timber. The classic choice for main doors and pooja rooms where presence matters.

Primer doors

Range: AL-178 to 189. Moulded panel doors delivered with a factory primer coat — a clean canvas ready for any paint colour your interior demands. Loved by builders and homeowners who want the palette decided on site.

Where each door belongs

Main door: teak or heavy laminate. Bedrooms: laminate, membrane or digital ranges. Pooja room: our devotional carved designs (AL-40–45, AL-160–165, AL-198–201). Note: our catalogue ranges are recommended for indoor use — ask us before using any design on a fully exposed exterior.

How to measure your door

Measure the clear frame opening — width and height in inches, at three points each (frames are rarely perfectly square). Share the smallest reading. Not sure? Send a photo of the opening on WhatsApp and we'll guide you in two minutes.

Good to Know

Frequently asked.

How does ordering work?

Add designs to your cart with exact sizes in inches — you can add the same design in multiple sizes — then checkout with your delivery address. Your order is recorded instantly and reaches our production team; we confirm price and advance, then manufacture and deliver. You can also send the order on WhatsApp in one tap.

Do I need an account to order?

No — you can order as a guest. But with a free account (one-time OTP on your phone), your details auto-fill on every order and you can track your full order history right here, just like any major shopping app.

Are the doors made to custom sizes?

Yes — every single door is manufactured to your exact measurements. We take orders as per your requirement; there is no fixed stock size.

Which doors suit bathrooms or wet areas?

Our catalogue ranges are recommended for indoor use. For high-moisture areas, message us — we'll recommend the right construction for your specific situation rather than let you order something unsuitable.

Do the actual doors match the catalogue photos?

The catalogue is a design reference — actual design and shade may vary 10–20% from the images, since every door is individually manufactured. What never varies is the build quality.

Can I cancel an order?

Because every door is custom-manufactured to your size, orders once placed cannot be cancelled. We confirm every detail with you before production begins, so there are no surprises.

Can I visit before ordering?

Absolutely — you're welcome at our facility to see the ranges in person. Message us to fix a time.
